fusions.name: Wet Canvas Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a sodden length of canvas that deals 4 damage to the first enemy in front of you, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fringed Curtain
fusions.desc: Hangs a fringe of baleen 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stiffened Stays
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail-Sailing
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and your water resistance rises by 10%.
